method: Offline Ue4Export wildcard [Text] export of all provider-visible *.uasset packages, followed by BOM-aware JSON decoding and serialized Blueprint call-reference census.

parser_provenance.configuration: ReadScriptData=true; temporary null-safe UEnum.WriteJson and UAssetImportData.SourceData guards; Ue4Export bin/Release/net8.0 x64 build

limitations: Serialized call references prove only that a call token is present in an exported Blueprint expression tree; they do not prove runtime reachability, execution order, ownership, or caller completeness.
The census does not resolve EX_VirtualFunction implementations, native virtual/indirect calls, ProcessEvent or delegate dispatch, or save/load invariants.
The parser null-safety edits were local to the temporary analysis checkout and are not part of any mod or shipped framework.
